Remark
[Bi-invariant pseudo-metric on $\mathrm{SL}(n,\mathbb {R})$]

Source: petersen:page-0058 ↗ def:pet-ch1-pseudo-riemannian ↗ def:pet-ch1-left-invariant-metric

1. ch1:1.6.28On the trace-zero Lie algebra $\mathfrak {sl}(n,\mathbb {R})$, the form \[ (X,Y)=\operatorname {tr}(XY) \] is symmetric, nondegenerate, and $\operatorname {Ad}$-invariant. It therefore defines a bi-invariant pseudo-Riemannian metric on $\operatorname {SL}(n,\mathbb {R})$.
